body: The request slip lies on my desk, its stamped "REFUSED" a stark contradiction to the polite smiles that greeted me yesterday. My curiosity gets the better of me as I pick it up, the creased paper a testament to its journey. I begin to examine it closely, searching for any hidden clue that might explain the refusal.
